labels.description: The labels of the agent, as key=value. They replace the labels of the agent's config file with the same keys. Empty removes each.

log_level.description: LogLevel is the level that a process logs at, one of its Values.
log_level.title: LogLevel

max_jobs.description: The most jobs that the agent runs at the same time. It replaces max_jobs of the agent's config file; empty keeps the file's.
